# External data

These files were obtained from public repositories at the commits pinned in
`SOURCES.json`; the licences of the original sources apply.

| Path | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `univ-bench.owl`, `lubm1/` | Univ-Bench ontology and one university generated with the original UBA 1.7 LUBM generator (seed 0) |
| `owl2bench/` | OWL2Bench ontologies (QL, RL, EL) and one university generated with the official OWL2Bench generator (seed 1) |
| `dbpedia_ontology.owl` | Official DBpedia ontology (DBpedia ontology tracker) |
| `dbpedia_joie_sample.nt` | 30,001-triple DBpedia sample from the JOIE DB111K data, built by `experiments/prepare_real_data.py` |
